command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# R needs a writable TMPDIR *and* HOME or it fails early and opaquely.
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

echo "== staged bytes must match their pin =="
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: identities.R does not match its pin"; exit 1; }

echo "== every reference file the spec declares must have arrived =="
# Checked BY NAME against the manifest, not by counting a glob: the first version counted
# 9 parquet + 4 csv and asserted 12, which failed the run before R ever started.
for f in datapage_v1-corrupt-checksum.parquet datapage_v1-snappy-compressed-checksum.parquet datapage_v1-uncompressed-checksum.parquet delta_binary_packed.parquet delta_binary_packed_expect.csv delta_byte_array.parquet delta_byte_array_expect.csv delta_encoding_optional_column.parquet delta_encoding_optional_column_expect.csv delta_encoding_required_column.parquet delta_encoding_required_column_expect.csv plain-dict-uncompressed-checksum.parquet rle-dict-uncompressed-corrupt-checksum.parquet; do
  test -s "/tmp/$f" || { echo "FAIL: /tmp/$f missing or empty"; exit 1; }
done
printf "  %s reference files present\n" "13"

Rscript identities.R 2>&1 | tee identities.log
RC="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }

uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
